description: Search SEC Form 4 insider transactions with rich filters: ticker, insider CIK, transaction code/category, date range, a dollar floor (min_value), institutional-ownership trend, and (Pro+) upper trade-size bounds plus post-trade return screening (1d/1w/1m/3m/6m, returns as fractions e.g. 0.05 = +5%). Returns transaction-level rows — shares, price, total value, transaction code, 10b5-1 flag, insider role flags. Use this for filtered or historical search across many companies/insiders; use get_recent_filings for an unfiltered live feed instead, or get_insider_transactions/get_company_insiders when you already have a specific insider or company. Free plan, including min_value; max_value/min_shares/max_shares/min_return_*/max_return_*/has_returns require Pro. Paginated, max 100/page, and paging depth is plan-limited (Free 20 pages, Starter 100, Pro+ unlimited) — for a bulk pull use the REST endpoint GET /v1/transactions/export (Business) instead of paging.

category.description: Include only one category of transactions. open_market = P/S (the signal most users want); grants = award/comp noise; derivatives = option exercises etc.

cik.description: Company CIK number — SEC's numeric filer identifier, e.g. 0000320193. Leading zeros optional.

code.description: Single SEC transaction code to filter to. P=open-market purchase, S=open-market sale, A=grant/award, M=option exercise, F=tax withholding on vesting, D=disposition to issuer, G=gift, C=conversion of derivative, J=other. Use `codes` instead to match more than one.

codes.description: Comma-separated list of SEC transaction codes to include, e.g. "P,S" (see `code` for the letter meanings). Multi-code superset of `code`.

exclude_10b5.description: If true, exclude pre-scheduled 10b5-1 plan trades. Recommended for signal analysis — filters out automatic, non-discretionary trades.

exclude_category.description: Exclude an entire category of transactions, e.g. exclude_category=derivatives drops all option-related rows.

exclude_codes.description: Comma-separated list of SEC transaction codes to exclude, e.g. "A,M,F,G" to drop grants, option exercises, tax withholding and gifts.

exclude_derivative.description: If true, drop derivative-security rows — the cleanest single "no options" switch.

filed_from.description: Inclusive start of the filed-date window, format YYYY-MM-DD. Filters on Filing.FiledAt (when the filing became public), not transactionDate — the two can differ by days to weeks. Use this to replay disclosures in the order the market actually saw them.

filed_to.description: Inclusive end of the filed-date window, format YYYY-MM-DD. Filters on Filing.FiledAt.

from.description: Start date, inclusive, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-01-01). Filters on transactionDate.

has_returns.description: If true, only return transactions with at least one computed post-trade return horizon (any of 1d/1w/1m/3m/6m). Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

insider_cik.description: Insider CIK number — SEC's numeric filer identifier, e.g. 0001214128. Leading zeros optional.

inst_ownership_trend.description: Filter by the trailing quarter-over-quarter trend in institutional (13F) ownership of the underlying company. No effect if institutional-ownership enrichment is disabled server-side; rows where the trend was suppressed for insufficient 13F coverage still match "stable".

max_return_1d.description: Maximum 1-day post-trade return as a fraction (e.g. -0.1 = -10%), inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

max_return_1m.description: Maximum 1-month post-trade return as a fraction, inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

max_return_1w.description: Maximum 1-week post-trade return as a fraction, inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

max_return_3m.description: Maximum 3-month post-trade return as a fraction, inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

max_return_6m.description: Maximum 6-month post-trade return as a fraction, inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

max_shares.description: Maximum number of shares, inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — the whole call is rejected with 403 on Free/Starter, not silently ignored.

max_value.description: Maximum trade value in USD (shares × price), inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — the whole call is rejected with 403 on Free/Starter, not silently ignored. Use min_value alone to screen by size on a free key.

min_return_1d.description: Minimum 1-day post-trade return, as a FRACTION not a percentage (0.05 = +5%), inclusive. Rows with no computed 1-day return are excluded. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

min_return_1m.description: Minimum 1-month post-trade return as a fraction (0.05 = +5%), inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

min_return_1w.description: Minimum 1-week post-trade return as a fraction (0.05 = +5%), inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

min_return_3m.description: Minimum 3-month post-trade return as a fraction (0.05 = +5%), inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

min_return_6m.description: Minimum 6-month post-trade return as a fraction (0.05 = +5%), inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — omitted or ignored on Free.

min_shares.description: Minimum number of shares, inclusive. Requires Pro plan or higher — the whole call is rejected with 403 on Free/Starter, not silently ignored.

min_value.description: Minimum trade value in USD (shares × price), inclusive. Available on every plan.

page.description: 1-based page number. Defaults to 1. Paging depth is plan-limited: Free reaches page 20, Starter page 100, Pro and above unlimited; beyond that the call returns 402 with the upgrade path. If you need the full history rather than a page of it, the REST endpoint GET /v1/transactions/export (Business plan) streams the entire filtered set as CSV in one request.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

significant.description: If true, preset = open-market trades only, no 10b5-1 plan trades, no derivatives. The "just show me real discretionary buys and sells" filter. Explicit params override it.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. AAPL or aapl. Also accepts a comma-separated list of up to 25 symbols (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT") to match any of them in one call; tokens are trimmed and upper-cased, empty tokens are ignored, and more than 25 symbols returns 400.

to.description: End date, inclusive, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-12-31). Filters on transactionDate.

name: get_transactions
